Question 1

Given the matrix B=[740−5], find a diagonal matrix D and an invertible matrix P such that D=P−1BP.

a
D=[700−5] and P=[510−4]
b
D=[700−5] and P=[−1034]
c
B is not diagonalizable
d
D=[700−5] and P=[1−103]
e
D=[7005] and P=[1−302]
